answer: Random peer audit stops fake identities. Each agent locks a deposit for 20 epochs and emits a pulse proving liveness. Checks are plain as a knoll: each epoch, 5 random auditors re-run one task and compare results. A failed audit slashes the deposit and flags its copies. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits plus 100 fees, so cost climbs in a spiral beyond any gain from extra votes. An honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
